name: hag

text: The hag is an Irish and Scottish folkloric figure. She is old, blind or one-eyed, and humpbacked, with rheumy eyes and a hairy chin. Her first appearance is not beautiful. But kiss her, and she becomes a gorgeous maiden in full bloom. This reversal appears in many stories of the great goddess of Sovereignty, of war goddesses like the Morrigan and Macha, and of the pre-Celtic creator goddess, the Cailleach. In Arthurian legend the hag appears as the Loathly Lady, who spurs on the quest for the Grail. She also appears as Ragnell, who leads her husband to understand what women really want.
objective: Document the hag as the shape-changing sovereignty figure of Irish and Scottish lore.
key_results: Describe her aged, ugly appearance and the kiss that restores her youth.
Connect her to Sovereignty, Morrigan, Macha, and the Cailleach.
